punchline: Harari ends a book about AI, work and politics by describing the two hours a day he spends sitting still.
thirty_sec: A friend pushed Harari to try a ten-day Vipassana retreat in 2000. Since then he meditates two hours every day and takes a retreat of a month or two each year. He ends 21 Lessons for the 21st Century with it because corporations and governments are learning to hack humans, so knowing your own mind matters more than before.
